commands.description: Create a document from a typed draft.
Validate and canonicalize a source document.
Inspect safe document structure, summary, or manifest.
Convert a document to a canonical format.
Apply one typed edit to a document.
Prepare a bounded render plan for preview.

document_schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://ttyinv.com/schema/ttyinv-v2.schema.json",
  "title": "ttyinv/v2 frontmatter configuration",
  "description": "Configuration keys for the ttyinv/v2 Markdown frontmatter. Document content is defined by SPEC.md.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["schema"],
  "properties": {
    "schema": { "const": "ttyinv/v2" },
    "format": { "enum": ["code-comma-dot", "code-dot-comma", "code-space-comma", "code-indian", "code-plain"], "default": "code-comma-dot" },
    "theme": { "enum": ["printable", "paper-white", "graphite", "blueprint", "ledger-pad", "solarized-light", "parchment", "midnight", "nord", "gruvbox-dark"], "default": "printable" },
    "font": { "enum": ["geist-mono", "cousine", "fira", "ibm-plex", "inconsolata", "jetbrains", "roboto", "source-code", "space", "ubuntu"], "default": "geist-mono" },
    "font-weight": { "enum": ["regular", "semibold"], "default": "regular" },
    "density": { "enum": ["comfortable", "compact"], "default": "comfortable" },
    "accent": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^#[0-9a-f]{6}$" },
    "font-scale": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 100, "maximum": 140, "default": 100 },
    "frame-inset": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 30, "maximum": 60, "default": 54 }
  }
}
